derivedFrom.method: Exact shared boundary vertices across committed simplified Admin-1 geometry; symmetric, sorted unique neighbours, no self-edges.
limitations: Natural Earth labels the 10m Admin-1 layer beta and does not guarantee complete or current global coverage.
Boundaries are cartographic source data and do not express a ProjectAtlas legal position.
Adjacency is derived from display geometry; enclaves, tunnels and ferries are not represented.
